name: Rattan Roundshields
headerMeta: Chivalric era · Melee Infantry (shields) · 115 leadership · T2 · Mastery
pitch: A nimble shielded melee unit that debuffs on charge, with exceptional piercing defense for its cost—but insufficient penetration to threaten heavy armor. Post-patch (Jun 2026), verify whether the leadership increase from 100→115 still justifies its role as a pike-trader.

doctrines.name: Iron Health Doctrine V
doctrines.note: Unit-unique: +300 HP, unlocks Ironsides (+175 piercing/slashing/blunt defence for 12s)

doctrines.name: Poisons Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: +140 all armour penetration, +60 poison DMG per stack, stacks up to 2x.
doctrines.note: Post-patch: +140 all AP, +60 poison DMG, stacks 2×; duration 6s→4s {2}

doctrines.name: Charge Defence Doctrine
doctrines.effect: -40% DMG taken while charging. Mandatory per Amya.

doctrines.name: Stamina Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: -24% charge CD, +1 charge target. Mandatory per Amya.

doctrines.name: LDS Doctrine
doctrines.note: Alternative if Charge DMG/Block Break needs doubling down

doctrines.name: HP Doctrines
doctrines.effect: Alt for Charge Defence: more fire resistance but worse trade vs Stalwart / Shieldmaiden charges. Top pick.
doctrines.note: Alternative for Charge Defence: more fire resistance but weaker vs Stalwart/Shieldmaiden charges

veterancy.label: Mixed allocation
veterancy.body: 6 points into Bottom Line; remainder into Top Line. No source indicates a single optimal veterancy line.

battleRole.positioning: Use as a mobile flank striker or engagement opener — not a primary frontline holder. Same charge-centric playstyle as Rattan Pikemen: apply poison debuff on entry, disengage only if survival is assured. {1}
battleRole.tips: Charge the engagement to apply debuff; the unit's value is upfront poison application and initial shock, not sustained melee holding. At ~8,000 HP with low slashing defense, the unit collapses quickly in prolonged grind — pick fights, don't hold the line. {3}

cards.name: Ironcap Swordsmen
cards.why: similar role, better charge damage and armor penetration — direct competition {3}

cards.name: Stalwarts
cards.why: invincible from the front; only viable target if flanked {3}

cards.name: Pike units
cards.why: exceptional piercing defense makes them good anti-pike traders {1}

controls.notes: Goal: charge to apply poison debuff, then use Ironsides (unlocked by Iron Health Doctrine V) when taking hits. The unit depends on the initial charge's shock value and poison-stacking damage, not on sustained damage output — armor penetration is low, so expect 600–1,000 damage per hit on armored targets, requiring many swings to break through. {3}

gaps: No fight-type strength ratings (Blob/Duel/Skirmish/Flank) in the Amya guide — unit's viability in different engagement types is not quantified.

Amya's guide (edited 2026-05-27) predates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch nerf (leadership 100→115, poison duration/damage reduced). No post-patch revision visible; cost-efficiency claims require validation against new leadership cost.
Evo Loz Gaming's 2021 video reflects balance state from 5+ years ago; playstyle remarks are stale and tactical context is historical reference only.
